sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: BAJOPONTINA S.A., a strategic partner of Arca Continental (the exclusive bottler and marketer of Coca-Cola Peru brands) with a presence in East and Central Lima and key provinces such as Huancayo, Huancavelica, and Huaraz—including 13 years of operations in the province of Huancayo—is beginning construction of the BAJOPONTINA S.A. DISTRIBUTION CENTER in the Sicaya district of Huancayo. In alignment with our vision to be the premier, customer-oriented, and profitable beverage distributor in the market, supported by a highly trained professional team committed to excellence in sales and distribution and the delivery of high-quality, prestigious products, this project aims to drive continuous improvement in service quality, prioritize our employees, and fulfill our commitment to the community by generating local employment.
